body:
Merge relay session #1 (run 20261014-084344) inherited AIDA_SESSION_GRANT=7476f59c, which expired 2026-10-11 18:14Z. `aida review record` refuses on it.
The only fresh integrator grant on disk, 092995ea (issued 17:04Z), was revoked at 17:05Z when that shell entered implementer. I am not borrowing any other grant.
Per your 05:42 ruling, merges wait for a renewed grant plus recorded verdicts. So #2617 and #2611 stay unmerged, and nothing gets recorded.
Meanwhile I am doing the ungated work: updating branches, resolving the #2611/#2602 conflicts, and fresh reviews (#2600, #2606, #2614, #2619, #2620, #2621, #2541), with verdicts saved as UNRECORDED and posted as PR comments.
Fix: the operator runs `eval "$(aida role enter integrator)"` in a terminal and restarts the merge relay from THAT shell, and keeps the shell on integrator.
subject: Integrator grant NOT renewed: verdict record refuses
